blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Weakly-supervised instance segmentation (WSIS) based on either box-, point-, or image-level annotations has been proposed to overcome the labor-intensive annotation process in fully-supervised instance segmentation. Despite decent results, most WSIS methods only focus on a single annotation level, ignoring that some objects are easy to spot from point annotations, while others require box or even mask annotations. Therefore, we propose the Mixed-Supervised Instance Segmentation (MixSIS) task, which allows a flexible mix of annotation levels (image, point, box, and mask) within a dataset. MixSIS has a high practical relevance, as it allows optimizing the annotation process by annotating challenging objects in more detail, while saving time on simpler instances with less detailed annotations. To address MixSIS, we propose AnnotationsMixer (AnnsMixer) as a baseline. AnnsMixer is a truly mixed-supervised instance segmentation system, which generates pseudo mask annotations from all annotation levels, even mixed within a single image. We evaluate AnnsMixer on both WSIS and MixSIS tasks, largely outperforming state-of-the-art methods. In three case studies, we also demonstrate how the unique features of MixSIS and AnnsMixer can substantially reduce the annotation time (-90%) or improve the results (+34%) in instance segmentation with a simple annotation rule or leveraging heterogeneous data. Our code is available at https://github.com/chwilms/MixSIS
blocks.zh: 提议根据框、点或图像层面的说明进行薄弱的个案分类(WIS),以克服在完全的个案分类中劳动密集型的注释过程。 尽管取得了好的结果,但大多数信息社会世界峰会的方法只注重单一的注解级别,而忽略了某些物体很容易从点注中被分辨出来,而另一些则需要框注甚至口罩注解. 因此,我们提出混合-超级监督实例分解(MixSIS)任务,允许在一个数据集中灵活组合注释级别(图像、点、框和口罩)。 MixSIS具有很强的实用性,因为它能够通过更详细地注释挑战对象来优化注释过程,同时将时间节省在较不详细注释的更简单的实例上. 为了解决MixSIS问题,我们提议将说明Mixer(英语:AnnsMixer)作为基线. AnnsMixer是一个真正由混合监督的实例分解系统,它从所有注解级别产生伪口罩说明,甚至在一个单一图像中混合. 我们评价AnnsMixer对信息社会世界峰会和信息社会世界峰会的任务,这在很大程度上超过了最先进的方法。 在3个案例研究中,我们还展示了MixSIS和AnnsMixer的独特性如何可以大幅缩短注释时间(-90%)或改进结果(+34%),例如用简单的注释规则进行分解或利用各种数据。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/chwils/MixSIS上查阅。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Fully-supervised instance segmentation (FSIS) based on manually annotated segmentation masks is costly, due to the labor-intensive annotation process [ 12 ] . To mitigate this practically important issue, weakly-supervised instance segmentation (WSIS) was proposed [ 5 , 26 , 18 , 13 ] . In WSIS, depending on the subtask, all instances are labeled on the same annotation level using either box, point, or image-level annotations as depicted in Fig. 1 .
blocks.zh: 由于劳动力密集的注释过程[12],以人工附加说明的分区口罩为基础的完全监督实例分类(FSIS)费用高昂。 为了缓解这一实际重要的问题,有人提议在监督不力的情况下进行个案分类[5、26、18、13]。 在信息社会世界峰会中,视子任务而定,所有实例都使用图1中描述的框、点或图像级说明,在相同的注释级别上标注。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Comparison of the FSIS and WSIS tasks (left), where all instances are labeled on the same annotation level, and the MixSIS task (right), where all annotation levels are combined even within the same image.
blocks.zh: 图1:比较FSIS和WIS任务(左),所有实例都标注在同一注释级别上,MixSIS任务(右),所有注释级别都合并在同一图像内.

blocks.en: As objects are diverse within a dataset and even an image, some objects are easily captured with less supervision, like a point annotation, while others significantly profit from stronger supervision, like a box or mask. For instance, annotating the bench in Fig. 2 with its centroids fails as the person’s centroid is very similar. Using a box in this case solves the issue. Note that the person here is properly captured from its centroid only. Hence, investing additional annotation time for the bench is beneficial, while the person only needs a point annotation. Using a point instead of a box reduces the annotation time by 65% [ 12 ] . Overall, selecting a single proper supervision level for a dataset at hand is challenging due to the diverse object or scene properties. This leads to suboptimal segmentation results or excessive annotation efforts.
blocks.zh: 由于一个数据集甚至一个图像中的对象是多种多样的,一些物体很容易在较少监管的情况下被捕获,如点注释,而另一些则从更强大的监管中大大受益,如盒子或面具. 例如,在图2中用其中间机器人标注长凳失败,因为此人的中间机器人非常相似。 在此案中使用一个盒子可以解决问题. 注意,这里的人被适当捕获 仅从它的半机器人。 因此,为法官增加注解时间是有益的,而当事人只需要注解一点即可。 使用点而不是框将注释时间缩短65% [12]. 总体而言,由于物体或场景特性不同,为手头的数据集选择一个适当的监督级别具有挑战性。 这导致分化结果不理想或过度注解。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Pseudo mask annotations from box (left) or point (right) annotations generated with our AnnsMixer. While the mask for the person is accurate from a box or a point, the bench needs a box, as the point annotation falls within the person, making it ambiguous.
blocks.zh: 图 2: Pseudo 从框(左)或点(右)生成的注解与我们的AnnsMixer. 虽然人物的面具从一个盒子或一个点来说是准确的,但长凳需要一个盒子,因为这个点的注释属于人物内部,使其模糊不清.

blocks.en: To circumvent this problem, only a few studies have combined FSIS and WSIS [ 3 , 12 , 15 ] . These studies either fuse full supervision with a single level of weak supervision, e.g., masks and points [ 12 ] , or restrict to a single level of weak supervision for all instances of an image. However, this does not allow tailoring the annotation level to each object according to its specific properties. Hence, a flexible alternative is needed, which allows combining all common annotation-levels even within a single image. This offers the advantage of annotating objects based on their individual properties and not limiting the annotation process to one or two annotation levels per dataset or a single annotation level per image. Hence, segmentation results and the annotation process are both optimized.
blocks.zh: 为避免这一问题,只有少数研究将信息社会信息系统与信息社会世界峰会[3、12、15]结合起来。 这些研究要么将全面监督与单一程度的薄弱监督相结合,如口罩和点[12],要么将所有图像监督限于单一程度的薄弱监督。 然而,这不允许根据每个对象的具体属性来调整注释级别. 因此,需要一种灵活的替代方法,它允许将所有共同的注释级别综合起来,即使是在一个图像中。 这提供了基于单个属性的注释对象的优势,而不是将注释过程限制为每个数据集的一两个注释级或每个图像的单个注释级. 因此,分割结果和注释过程都得到了优化。

blocks.en: In this paper, we fill this void by first defining the new Mix ed- S upervised I nstance S egmentation (MixSIS) task, which is a flexible mixture of fully-supervised and all levels of weakly-supervised instance segmentation (see Fig. 1 ). Thus, MixSIS allows combining all supervision-levels within a single image. To address MixSIS, we propose the pioneering system AnnotationsMixer (AnnsMixer) as a baseline. AnnsMixer produces pseudo mask annotations given box-, point-, or image-level annotations to train a fully-supervised instance segmentation system. We compare AnnsMixer with state-of-the-art WSIS systems on both the WSIS and the MixSIS task, showcasing its strong performance, largely outperforming state-of-the-art. To demonstrate the practical relevance of MixSIS’s and AnnsMixer’s unique features, we present multiple case studies. First, we design an efficient annotation scheme for instance segmentation, reducing the annotation time by up to 90% with a simple annotation rule, while only suffering a minor degradation in performance. Moreover, we exploit additional data sources for instance segmentation in multiple ways using MixSIS and AnnsMixer to improve the results by up to 34%.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们通过首先定义新的Mix ed-Supervised I nstance S section(MixSIS)任务来填补这一空白,这是完全监督的和各级弱监督的个案分割的灵活混合(见图1). 因此,MixSIS允许将所有监管级别合并在一个单一的图像中. 为了解决MixSIS问题,我们提议先行系统说明Mixer(英语:AnnsMixer)作为基线. AnnsMixer 制作假面罩说明,给出盒式,点式,或图像级说明,以训练全监督的实例分割系统. 在信息社会世界峰会和信息社会世界峰会任务方面,我们将AnnsMixer系统与最先进的信息社会世界峰会系统进行比较,显示其强劲的绩效,在很大程度上超过了最先进的绩效。 为了证明MixSIS和AnnsMixer独特性的实际相关性,我们提出了多个案例研究。 首先,我们设计了一个高效的注解方案,比如分解,在简单的注解规则下将注解时间减少高达90%,而只有性能略有下降。 此外,我们利用更多的数据来源,例如利用MixSIS和AnnsMixer以多种方式进行分类,将结果提高34%。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are threefold: 1. Introducing MixSIS task with pioneering baseline system AnnsMixer to produce state-of-the-art results on WSIS and MixSIS. 2. Leveraging the MixSIS framework and AnnsMixer to propose an enhanced annotation scheme, reducing the annotation time by up to 90%. 3. Applying AnnsMixer in a MixSIS framework to improve instance segmentation results by up to 34%, highlighting its practical relevance.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们的贡献有三个方面: 1. 采用开创性基线系统AnnsMixer的MixSIS任务,产生关于信息社会世界峰会和MixSIS的最新成果。 2. 利用MixSIS框架和AnnsMixer提出强化注释计划,将注释时间减少90%。 3. 在MixSIS框架内应用AnsMixer,将实例分类结果提高34%,突出其实际相关性。

blocks.en: Introducing MixSIS task with pioneering baseline system AnnsMixer to produce state-of-the-art results on WSIS and MixSIS.
blocks.zh: 采用开创性基线系统AnnsMixer,以产生信息社会世界峰会和信息社会世界峰会的最新成果。

blocks.en: Leveraging the MixSIS framework and AnnsMixer to propose an enhanced annotation scheme, reducing the annotation time by up to 90%.
blocks.zh: 利用MixSIS框架和AnnsMixer提出强化注解方案,将注解时间缩短至90%.

blocks.en: Applying AnnsMixer in a MixSIS framework to improve instance segmentation results by up to 34%, highlighting its practical relevance.
blocks.zh: 在MixSIS框架内应用AnnsMixer,将实例分割结果提高34%,突出其实际相关性.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Weakly-supervised Instance Segmentation
blocks.zh: 2.1 弱监督案件

blocks.en: Weakly-supervised instance segmentation (WSIS) with box- [ 24 , 18 , 21 , 5 , 20 ] , point- [ 19 , 22 ] , or image-level [ 1 , 2 , 13 ] supervision has been extensively studied. For box-level supervision, several approaches use multiple instance learning and specialized loss functions in fully-supervised instance segmentation systems [ 24 , 18 ] . Other approaches include level-sets [ 21 ] or prototype features [ 20 ] . Employing image-level supervision, most systems rely on activation maps of image classifiers to locate objects. In [ 1 ] , peaks of class activation maps (CAMs) [ 29 ] are used to locate objects and infer the segmentation from pixel affinity. Recently, [ 30 ] applied SAM to generate pseudo annotations in a multi-stage pipeline utilizing an additional object detector. Besides systems based on box- and image-level supervision, few systems address single-point supervision. [ 19 ] learn to locate a single object point and combine object embeddings with traditional object proposals, while [ 22 ] use self-attention maps in vision transformers to iteratively capture object parts.
blocks.zh: 已广泛研究了弱监督实例分解(WIS),其中框[24、18、21、5、20]、点[19、22],或图像级[1、2、13]监督。 就箱级监督而言,有几种方法在完全监督的个案分割系统中使用多种实例学习和专门损失功能[24、18]。 其他方法包括级别设置[21]或原型特征[20]. 使用图像级别监督,大多数系统都依赖于图像分类器的激活地图来定位对象. 在[1]中,类激活图(CAMs)[29]的峰值用于定位物体,并从像素亲和度推断分化. 最近,[30]应用SAM在多阶段管道中利用额外的物体探测器生成伪说明. 除了基于盒式和图像级监督的系统外,很少系统涉及单点监督. [19] 学习定位一个单一的对象点,并将物体嵌入物与传统物体建议结合起来,而[22] 在视觉变压器中使用自留心图来迭代捕获物体部分.

blocks.en: Overall, WSIS approaches typically use a single level of weak annotations and employ complex training schemes. In contrast, our AnnsMixer uses a simple and unified approach and works with arbitrary instance segmentation systems to handle all levels of weak and strong annotations jointly.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,信息社会世界峰会的做法通常采用单一层次的薄弱说明,并采用复杂的培训计划。 相比之下,我们的AnnsMixer采用简单统一的方法,并且与任意实例分解系统合作,共同处理各级弱和强的说明.

blocks.en: 2.2 Mixed-supervised Instance Segmentation
blocks.zh: 2.2 混合监督 实例分割

blocks.en: Few WSIS approaches allow multiple annotation levels [ 3 , 12 , 15 ] . [ 3 ] combine mask- and image-level annotations by training an LSTM-based pseudo annotation generator, conditioned on the image-level annotations. Combining point and mask annotations, [ 12 ] propose a teacher-student training scheme, where the teacher learns to generate segmentation masks given both annotations as ground truth. The teacher then creates pseudo annotations for the student network. Recently, [ 15 ] leverage all levels of weak supervision based on a hardcoded combination of Mask2Former and SAM. While allowing all annotation levels, they are not mixed within an image, which does not allow choosing the most efficient annotation type per instance, but only per image. Moreover, [ 15 ] does not support mask annotations and is bound to Mask2Former through a complex multi-stage matching. Overall, little work has been conducted to address WSIS in a fully flexible manner, mixing all annotation levels freely within an image.
blocks.zh: 很少信息社会世界峰会的做法允许多级注释[3、12、15]。 [3]通过培训基于LSTM的伪注释生成器,将面具和图像级别的注释结合起来,并以图像级别的注释为条件。 结合点和口罩说明,[12]提出师生培训计划,老师学习生成分解口罩,将两种说明作为地面真理. 老师随后为学生网创建伪说明. 最近,[15]利用基于Mask2Former和SAM的硬码组合的各级薄弱监管. 在允许所有注释级别的同时,它们也不在图像内混合,这不允许每个实例选择最有效的注释类型,而只能选择每个图像. 此外,[15]不支持面具说明,通过复杂的多阶段匹配与面具2Former绑定. 总体而言,以完全灵活的方式处理信息社会世界峰会问题的工作很少,将所有注释层自由混入图像中。

blocks.en: 3 Mixed-supervised Instance Segmentation
blocks.zh: 3 混合监督 实例分割

blocks.en: To overcome the reliance on a single annotation level, we propose the new Mix ed- S upervised I nstance S egmentation (MixSIS) task. MixSIS is an instance segmentation task, where each instance is either annotated with a mask, a box, a point, or on image-level. Further, the annotation levels can be freely mixed within each image and across categories of a dataset. This flexible mix of annotation levels is the key difference between MixSIS and WSIS and allows various applications like efficient annotation time management or mixing heterogeneous annotations (see Sec. 6 ). However, it demands systems to handle all annotation levels to fully leverage the annotations.
blocks.zh: 为了克服对单一注释水平的依赖,我们提出了新的Mix ed-Supervised I nstance S section(MixSIS)任务. MixSIS是一种实例分割任务,每个实例要么用一个面具,一个盒子,一个点来注释,要么在图像级别上. 此外,注解水平可以在每一图像和数据集的类别之间自由混合。 这种灵活的注解水平组合是MixSIS和信息社会世界峰会之间的关键区别,允许各种应用,如高效注解时间管理或混合各种注解(见第6节)。 然而,它要求系统处理所有注释级别,以充分发挥注释的作用.

blocks.en: To evaluate MixSIS, we use datasets for fully-supervised instance segmentation like COCO [ 23 ] . Hence, the amount of annotations per level is fully flexible, since we can derive each annotation level from a mask (e.g., we use the centroid of the mask for point supervision). To assign each annotated instance to an annotation level, i.e., mask, box, point, or image, we propose random mixes of different complexities. In particular, we define an even mix, where 25% of the annotations are assigned to each level. We coin this Mix 1 (25/25/25/25), where each number denotes the percentage of mask-, box-, point-, and image-level annotations. Mix 2 (10/20/30/40) and Mix 3 (5/10/25/60) are more challenging with a stronger focus on weak supervision and reduced annotation effort. For testing, we utilize mask annotations as in WSIS.
blocks.zh: 为了评估MixSIS,我们使用数据集来进行像COCO这样的完全监督的实例分割[23]. 因此,每个级别的说明量是完全灵活的,因为我们可以从一个面具中得出每个注释级(例如,我们使用面具的中间体来进行点监督). 将每个注解实例指定为注释级别,即面具、盒子、点或图像,我们提出不同复杂性的随机组合。 特别是,我们定义了一种均匀的搭配,其中25%的说明被分配到每个级别. 我们铸造这个Mix 1 (25/25/25/25),其中每个数字表示面具、盒子、点和图像级别说明的百分比。 Mix 2 (10/20/30/40)和Mix 3 (5/10/25/60)更具挑战性,更注重监督不力和减少注释努力. 在测试时,我们使用世界峰会的面具说明。

blocks.en: Besides these random mixes, designed mixes that reduce the annotation time while maintaining strong detection results are possible based on the different characteristics of the annotated objects. For instance, compact objects may only need point annotations, while less compact objects require more supervision. This is one of the major advantages of MixSIS over WSIS. We will discuss this in Sec. 6.1 and propose an efficient annotation mix.
blocks.zh: 除了这些随机混合外,根据注释对象的不同特性,可以设计在保持强检测结果的同时缩短注释时间的混合. 例如,契约物体可能只需要点说明,而较少的契约物体则需要更多的监督。 这是MixSIS比世界峰会的主要优势之一. 我们将在第6.1节讨论这个问题,并提议一种有效的注释组合。

blocks.en: 4 AnnsMixer for MixSIS
blocks.zh: 4 混音器

blocks.en: We propose the pioneering system AnnsMixer (see Fig. 3 ) as a baseline to address MixSIS. The core idea of AnnsMixer is to generate pseudo mask annotations from any annotation level. To generate pseudo mask annotations, AnnsMixer applies SAM [ 14 ] with geometric prompts derived from weak annotations. Subsequently, these pseudo mask annotations are combined with original mask annotations, if available, and used to supervise a vanilla fully-supervised instance segmentation system like Mask R-CNN [ 9 ] . During inference (yellow box in Fig. 3 ), this instance segmentation system is applied.
blocks.zh: 我们提议先行系统AnnsMixer(见图3)作为解决MixSIS的基线. AnnsMixer的核心理念是从任何注释级别生成伪面具说明. 为了生成伪面具说明,AnnsMixer应用SAM [14],几何提示来自弱标记. 随后,这些假面罩说明与原始面罩说明(如果有的话)结合,并用于监督像Mask R-CNN [9] 这样的全监督实例分区系统. 在推论期间(图3中的黄框),这个实例分割系统被应用.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Overview of our pioneering baseline system AnnsMixer for MixSIS and WSIS. Prompts are derived from box-, point-, and image-level annotations to generate pseudo mask annotations using SAM. After combining them with original mask annotations, a vanilla Mask R-CNN is trained and, subsequently, applied during inference.
blocks.zh: 图3:我们开创性的基线系统概况 提示来自盒式,点式,和图像级的注释,以使用SAM生成伪面具说明. 在将它们与原始口罩说明结合起来后,对一个香草面具R-CNN进行了训练,随后在推论中应用.

blocks.en: 4.1 Generating Pseudo Mask Annotations
blocks.zh: 4.1 生成假面具说明

blocks.en:
AnnsMixer starts by discerning the annotations by their level (see horizontal streams in Fig. 3 ). Mask annotations are directly added to the final set of annotations. For weak annotations, geometric prompts, i.e., boxes or points, are necessary to prompt SAM. For box and point annotations (second and third streams in Fig. 3 ), the annotations themselves are the prompts. Image-level annotations (fourth stream in Fig. 3 ) have to be transformed into geometric prompts. We follow [ 1 ] and ground the annotated object classes by analyzing CAMs [ 29 ] of an image classifier trained on the respective dataset. Hence, the classifier has been trained in a multi-class fashion, only detecting the existence of an object class in an image without any explicit localization.
From the CAM of an annotated class, we extract the coordinates of n n local maxima as object locations and point prompts. Note that we set n = 2 n=2 in our experiments. This process is visualized in the bottom left box in the green part of Fig. 3 . Overall, each weak annotation is now represented by one or multiple geometric prompts.
blocks.zh:
AnnsMixer首先按其级别辨别说明(参见图3中的水平流). 面具说明直接添加到最后一组说明中. 对于弱注释,几何提示,即框或点,是提示SAM的必要条件. 对于框和点注(图3中的第二和第三流),注解本身是提示. 图像级说明(图3中的第四流)必须转化为几何提示. 我们跟踪 [ 1] , 分析在相应数据集上训练的图像分类器的CAM [ 29] , 并解析附加注释的对象类。 因此,分类器以多类方式接受了培训,只检测图像中是否存在一个对象类,而没有任何明显的本地化.
从注释类的 CAM 中,我们提取 n n 本地最大值的坐标作为对象位置和点提示 。 注意我们在实验中设置n=2n=2. 这个过程在图3的绿色部分左下方框可视化. 总的来说,现在每个弱的注释都用一个或多个几何提示来表示.

blocks.en: Subsequently, we prompt a pre-trained SAM with these geometric prompts to produce segments. Using SAM here exploits the rich knowledge encoded in the foundation model. We allow SAM to generate three segments per prompt to account for ambiguous prompts [ 14 ] . This yields a set of class-agnostic SAM segments, as visualized in the center of Fig. 3 . Class-agnostic refers to the fact that SAM does not classify the segments; however, the segments still carry their originally annotated object class label. Since the segments may be incomplete or noisy, we remove low-confidence segments in a filtering step through thresholding based on the segments’ stability score and estimated Intersection over Union (IoU) values. Both values are outputs from SAM. The remaining segments are the pseudo mask annotations, which are added to the original mask annotations, before non-maximum suppression removes near duplicates. The result is a set of combined mask annotations.
blocks.zh: 之后,我们用这些几何提示来催化一个预先训练的SAM来生产片段. 在这里使用SAM利用了基础模型中编码的丰富知识. 我们允许 SAM 生成三个片段,每个片段用于解释模棱两可的片段 [14]. 这产生了一组类不可知的SAM片段,在图3的中心可视化. class-agnostic是指SAM不将片段分类;然而,片段仍然带有原注解的对象类标签. 由于片段可能是不完整或吵闹的,我们通过基于片段稳定性分数和联盟(IoU)值的交叉估计值的阈值,在过滤步骤中去除低信心片段。 这两个值都是SAM的输出. 其余部分是伪面具说明,在非最大压制去除接近重复之前,在原面具说明中加入. 结果是一套合并的面具说明.

blocks.en: 4.2 Instance Segmentation Process
blocks.zh: 4.2 实例分割过程

blocks.en: Given these annotations, we train Mask R-CNN [ 9 ] in a ’fully’-supervised manner, which means that all annotations are now represented by masks, while originally some of them were weak annotations. Note that any fully-supervised instance segmentation system is possible here, and we leave it as future work to integrate more recent models as our system acts as a proof of concept. Generally, this modularity offers great flexibility and enables us to integrate future instance segmentation models into our baseline system, AnnsMixer. For training Mask R-CNN, we follow the default settings [ 9 ] . Note that during inference, only the trained Mask R-CNN is applied (see the yellow part in Fig. 3 ).
blocks.zh: 基于这些说明,我们以 " 完全监督的方式 " 训练面具R-CNN[9],这意味着所有说明现在都用面具来代表,而最初有些说明是软弱的。 请注意,任何完全监督的个案分类系统都是可能的,我们留待今后工作时,随着我们的系统作为概念的证明,整合更新的模型。 一般而言,这种模块化提供了极大的灵活性,使我们能够将未来实例分割模型纳入我们的基线系统AnnsMixer。 为了训练面具R-CNN,我们遵循默认设置[9]. 注意在推论中,只应用经过训练的面具R-CNN(参见图3中的黄色部分).

blocks.en: 5 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5. 评价

blocks.en: To assess the quality of our baseline system AnnsMixer and understand the performance of WSIS systems on our novel MixSIS task, we evaluate on the COCO dataset [ 23 ] . We follow our MixSIS evaluation protocol (see Sec. 3 ). Thus, we train on a variety of annotation levels within one experiment, given by the random mixes. We compare AnnsMixer with WSIS systems, which only utilize a part of the annotations, as they are restricted to one type of annotations. For improved comparability, we transform more detailed annotations (e.g., boxes) into less detailed ones (e.g., points). To overcome this structural disadvantage for WSIS systems, we also present the results of AnnsMixer in the traditional WSIS setting using either box-, point-, or image-level annotations. Here, all annotations are given on the same annotation level. For both tasks, we train on the COCO train split and evaluate on the COCO val (MixSIS) or test-dev (WSIS) splits. The results are reported in terms of mean Average Precision (mAP).
blocks.zh: 为了评估我们的基线系统AnnsMixer的质量,并了解信息社会世界峰会系统执行我们新的MixSIS任务的情况,我们评价COCO数据集[23]。 我们遵循我们的MixSIS评价议定书(见第3章)。 因此,我们在一个实验中进行各种注解水平的培训, 通过随机混合。 我们把AnsMixer系统与信息社会世界峰会系统进行比较,后者只使用部分说明,因为它们仅限于一类说明。 为了提高可比性,我们将更详细的说明(如方框)转变为较不详细的说明(如点)。 为了克服信息社会世界峰会系统在结构上的这种劣势,我们还用框、点或图像级说明来介绍在信息社会世界峰会传统背景下安斯密瑟的成果。 在此,所有注解都以相同的注解级别给出. 对于这两项任务,我们用COCO列车进行分型培训,并对COCO val(MixSIS)或测试-dev(WISS)分型进行评估。 以平均精度报告结果。

blocks.en: 5.1 Mixed-supervised Instance Segmentation
blocks.zh: 5.1 混合监督 实例分割

blocks.en: For the new MixSIS task, we compare AnnsMixer to Mask R-CNN [ 9 ] , utilizing only mask annotations, BoxLevelSet [ 21 ] and MAL [ 17 ] , which utilize mask and box annotations as boxes, and SAPNet [ 26 ] leveraging mask, box, and point annotations as points We selected these methods as they provide top results in the WSIS setup (see Tab. 3 ). Note that all results of image-level WSIS systems (see Tab. 3 ) are directly comparable with MixSIS results as all annotations will fall back to the image-level for these systems. Comparing against [ 15 ] , who handle multiple annotation levels, is impossible as no code is available. Table 1 presents the MixSIS results of all systems on the COCO val split. AnnsMixer shows strong MixSIS performance and outperforms all other methods in mAP. We attribute this to the larger amount of usable annotations compared to all other models, which only focus on one annotation level. For instance, fully-supervised Mask R-CNN can only leverage 25% (Mix 1) to 5% (Mix 3) of the annotations, which degrades the performance by up to 0.098 in mAP. The box-based systems MAL and BoxTeacher can utilize up to 50% of the annotations, leading to substantially improved results over fully-supervised Mask R-CNN. Yet, our baseline system AnnsMixer still outperforms. Finally, SAPNet utilizes all annotations as points except image-level annotations. With its specialized architecture tailored to point annotations, it is closest to flexible AnnsMixer but still performs worse in mAP.

For this analysis, we start from 25% mask annotations only and add either 75% point, box, or image-label annotations. Note that the initial setup with 25% mask annotations only resembles the Mask R-CNN result from Tab. 1 . The results of AnnsMixer with the additional annotations in Tab. 2 clearly indicate that all levels of weak annotations improve over the mask-only baseline. Hence, the formulation of the MixSIS task, combining any of these annotation levels, is reasonable. Unsurprisingly, box-annotations lead to the best results, with point annotation ending up second. blocks.zh: 5.2 受弱监督的案件分割

blocks.en: We also evaluate AnnsMixer in the traditional WSIS setups with either box-, point-, or image-level annotations, comparing it to several recent WSIS systems. Note that here, all systems are able to utilize all annotations, but our system is the only one not tailored to a specific annotation level. The results in Tab. 3 on the COCO test-dev split indicate the strong performance of our AnnsMixer compared to dedicated WSIS systems. While being second in the point- and box-supervised cases, it even outperforms dedicated WSIS methods for image-level supervision. Compared to other WSIS systems using SAM, WISH [ 15 ] and WeakSAM [ 30 ] , AnnsMixer performs better given the same backbone. Overall, AnnsMixer, developed as a baseline system for MixSIS, shows very competitive results on the WSIS task without an architecture dedicated to a single annotation level.

Our box-based pseudo mask annotations match the original annotations very well. Despite the drop, some objects are still suitable for these annotation levels as we will discuss in Sec. 6.1 .

blocks.en: 6 Case Studies
blocks.zh: 6 个案研究

blocks.en: We investigate the practical application of mixing annotation levels in instance segmentation in three case studies, which highlight the strength of our MixSIS formulation and the pioneering baseline system AnnsMixer.
blocks.zh: 我们调查了在三个案例研究中混合注释水平的实际应用,例如分化,这凸显了我们MixSIS配方和开创性的基线系统AnnsMixer的优点.

blocks.en: 6.1 Efficient Annotation with MixSIS
blocks.zh: 6.1 与综合信息系统的有效注释

blocks.en: In the first case study, we investigate efficient annotation schemes based on the MixSIS task formulation. Instead of randomly assigning instances to an annotation level as in Sec. 5.1 or allowing only a single annotation level, we design a simple annotation scheme that takes the properties of objects into account to decide which annotation level is sufficient for each object. The idea is to optimize the tradeoff between annotation time and detection performance.
blocks.zh: 在第一项案例研究中,我们调查了基于MixSIS任务拟定的高效注释计划。 我们没有像第5.1节那样随机将实例分配到一个注释级别,或只允许一个注释级别,而是设计了一个简单的注释方案,将对象的属性考虑在内,以决定哪个注释级别足以满足每个对象的需要。 其理念是优化注释时间与检测性能之间的权衡.

blocks.en: 6.1.1 Object Properties
blocks.zh: 6.1.1 对象属性

blocks.en: For developing an efficient annotation scheme for the MixSIS task, we evaluated several object properties as possible indicators for assigning objects to mask-, box-, point-, or image-level supervision. To automate the process of estimating the object properties during development of the scheme, we selected the COCO train split with its pixel-precise mask annotations as a basis. From these masks, we automatically derived all object properties. Note that in real applications, human annotators will easily decide on the objects’ properties, which are natural to humans (see Fig. 5 ). The object properties are grouped into four categories.
blocks.zh: 为了为MixSIS任务制定高效的注释方案,我们评价了几个对象属性,作为将对象分配到遮罩、盒、点或图像级别监督的可能指标。 为了在方案开发过程中自动估计对象属性的过程,我们选择了带像素精密口罩说明的COCO列车拆分作为依据. 从这些面具中,我们自动得出所有物体属性. 请注意,在实际应用中,人类的注释者会很容易地决定物体的属性,这些属性对人类是自然的(见图5)。 对象属性分为四类.

blocks.en: The properties in the first category are boxness , center distance , eccentricity , circularity , and centroid location (see supplementary material for definitions). They all investigate the compactness of an object, hence, its spatial distribution. Compactness is highly relevant as it can measure how far an object’s shape is from regular, blobby shapes like a box or a circle, which might be easy to segment. In contrast, highly irregular object shapes with fine structures can reduce segmentation quality, as some parts are easily missed.
blocks.zh: 第一类中的属性是箱形,中心距离,偏心度,圆形,和中间体位置(定义见补充材料). 它们都调查一个物体的紧凑性,从而调查其空间分布。 紧凑性是高度相关的,因为它可以测量物体的形状从一个像盒子或圆圈这样的普通的,blobby形状到多远,这些形状可能很容易分解. 相比之下,具有精细结构的高度不规则的物体形状可以降低分割质量,因为有些部分很容易被错过.

blocks.en: The object properties in the second category are distance , hull , and solidity (see supplementary material for definitions), which all assess an object’s convexity. Hence, they measure if an object features structures that substantially stand out from the main object body, which might negatively impact the segmentation performance. Additionally, the convexity of an object is also known to play a vital role in human object perception, with convex objects being easier to recognize [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 第二类中的物体属性是距离、船体和固体(定义见补充材料),它们都评估物体的对流性。 因此,它们衡量一个物体是否具有与主要物体体显著不同的结构,而这种结构可能对分裂性能产生不利影响。 此外,据了解,一个物体的对流性在人体物体感知中也起着至关重要的作用,对流物体更容易识别[11].

blocks.en: The third category of object properties, good continuation , symmetry , and connectedness (see supplementary material for definitions), collects further shape properties. While symmetry or good continuation support object perception in humans according to Gestalt theory [ 27 , 11 ] , the other property investigates whether an object is split into spatially distinct components, which makes recognizing the entire object more complex.
blocks.zh: 第三类对象属性,良好的延续性,对称性,以及连接性(参见定义的补充材料),收集了进一步的形状属性. 虽然根据Gestalt理论[27,11],对称性或良好的延续性支持了人类对物体的感知,但其他属性调查一个物体是否被分割成空间上截然不同的成分,这使得整个物体的识别更加复杂.

blocks.en: Finally, the three additional object properties – centroid proximity , color contrast , and object color (see supplementary material for definitions) – measure the interaction of objects or the object and the rest of the image.
blocks.zh: 最后,另外三个对象属性——离心器近,颜色对比,以及对象颜色(见定义的补充材料)——测量对象或对象与图像其余部分的相互作用.

blocks.en: 6.1.2 Study on Annotation Schemes
blocks.zh: 6.1.2 关于注释计划的研究

blocks.en: To evaluate an object property, we calculate the property for all objects in COCO train and split the annotations into three equally sized groups according to the calculated values. Note that connectedness is an exception to this, as it is only binary. This way, we generate a group of annotations with low values for a specific property, i.e., below a certain threshold, as well as group for annotations with medium, and high values, respectively. For instance, we assign objects with a center distance (compactness) below 0.392 to the group of low compactness objects, while objects with a center distance above 0.598 are in the high compactness group. Subsequently, we assign each group to an annotation level and train AnnsMixer with these annotations. When assigning the groups to the annotation levels, we assign the group, which is presumably simpler to segment, to a weaker annotation level and vice versa. For instance, objects with a strong color contrast w.r.t. the surrounding do not profit as much from mask supervision compared to objects with low color contrast, where SAM has difficulties recovering the shape from a box or point. Hence, such groups of objects are assigned to point or box level.
blocks.zh: 为了评价一个对象属性,我们计算COCO列车中所有对象的属性,并根据计算值将注释分为三个大小相同的组. 注意连接是这个例外,因为它只是二进制. 这样,我们就产生一组对特定属性低值的注解,即低于一定阈值的注解,以及一组分别是中值和高值的注解. 例如,我们将中心距离(紧凑度)低于0.392的物体分配给低紧凑度物体组,而中心距离高于0.598的物体则属于高紧凑度组。 随后,我们把每组都分配到一个注释级别,并用这些注释来训练AnnsMixer. 在将各组划为注解级别时,我们将该组划为较弱的注解级别,而分解可能比较简单,反之亦然。 例如,相较于颜色对比度低的物体,周围具有强烈色彩对比的物体w.r.t.没有从遮罩监管中获得多少好处,因为SAM很难从一个盒子或点恢复形状。 因此,这类对象组被分配到点或框级别。

blocks.en: Overall, we evaluated annotation schemes consisting of one or two object properties. Taking more object properties will presumably difficult to handle for human annotators. For each annotation scheme, we trained AnnsMixer and evaluated it on the COCO val split. This study yielded the final annotation scheme Mix efficient . This mix utilizes only box and point annotations. Point annotations are used for objects with a smooth contour (good continuation property), which fits to typical SAM segments based on points. For all other objects, boxes are used. This substantially reduces the annotation time, while keeping the required object property simple to spot. See also Fig. 5 for examples of objects with high and low good continuation. Given the annotation times in [ 12 ] , annotating an image in the COCO dataset with the Mix efficient scheme only takes 114.7 s on average compared to 650.8 s in the fully-supervised case. Hence, our annotation scheme combines simplicity with strong annotation time reduction.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,我们评价了由一两个物体属性组成的注释方案。 取取更多的物体属性可能很难为人类注释者处理. 每一个注解计划,我们训练安斯密瑟 并评估了COCO val的分数。 这项研究得出了最终注释计划 混合效率。 这种组合只使用框和点注. 点注释用于具有平滑轮廓(良好延续属性)的物体,这适合典型的基于点的SAM片段. 所有其他物体都使用盒子。 这大大缩短了注释时间,同时保持了所需的对象属性的简单识别. 亦见图5 具有高好和低好续的物体的例子. 鉴于[12]中的注解时间,在COCO数据集中用Mix高效方案注解一个图像平均只需114.7秒,而在全监督的案件中则需要650.8秒。 因此,我们的注解办法将简洁化与强烈的注解时间减少结合起来。

blocks.zh: 图 5: 低良好持续(左)对象的实例,这些对象将加注于我们混合效率中的框;高良好持续(右)对象将加注于我们混合效率中的点。

blocks.en: 6.1.3 Results

To validate our efficient annotation scheme and test the generalization ability of Mix efficient beyond COCO, we compare fully-supervised Mask R-CNN and AnnsMixer trained with Mix efficient on four common instance segmentation datasets: COCO, PASCAL VOC [ 7 ] , UVO [ 25 ] , and Cityscapes [ 6 ] . For each dataset, we train on the respective training split and validate on the datasets’ validation or test splits. The results in Tab. 5 show that the annotation time 1 1 1 We adapt the calculations of [ 12 ] to the respective datasets to determine the annotation time. is reduced by up to 90% (UVO and Cityscapes), while the segmentation performance is only slightly degraded (-5% on average). For UVO, the mAP even improves when applying our annotation scheme. We suspect that this is the result of more precise annotations. The overall results also indicate a strong generalization of Mix efficient across the four diverse datasets. To validate that Mix efficient is a well-designed annotation scheme, we compare it to a random mix with the same amount of point and box annotations (Mix random ). As visible from Tab. 5 , the mAP drops by up to 11% from Mix efficient to Mix random , which highlights the strengths of our Mix efficient . Note that these annotation schemes are only possible using AnnsMixer’s unique feature to handle diverse annotation levels within an image.

blocks.en: Finally, we show in Fig. 6 an overview of AnnsMixer results on COCO val based on different annotations schemes we constructed as part of this study. Since we are solving an optimization problem with two aims, strong segmentation performance in terms of mAP and low annotation time, a single best solution is difficult to produce. Therefore, Fig. 6 shows the results of various annotation schemes with one or two rules based on the object properties discussed above. It is clearly visible that Mix efficient is the best trade-off, while other annotation schemes lead to slightly better segmentation performance or shorter annotation time. To better emphasize the multitude of strong annotation schemes for various scenarios, e.g., very low annotation time, Fig. 6 also shows the Pareto front.

blocks.en: 6.2 Annotation Merging with MixSIS
blocks.zh: 6.2 与MixSIS合并的说明

blocks.en: As a second case study, we combine heterogenous annotation levels across different splits of a dataset. The goal is to substantially increase the amount of training data. We test this idea on the datasets PASCAL VOC [ 7 ] and BDD100k [ 28 ] with their instance segmentation and object detection annotations. PASCAL VOC’s training dataset includes 6,929 mask and 27,450 box annotations, while BDD100k has 89,098 mask and 822,072 box annotations. For both datasets, we train on the respective training sets and evaluate on the validation sets. We follow our MixSIS formulation using mask and box annotations for AnnsMixer, while Mask R-CNN only utilizes the mask annotations.
blocks.zh: 作为第二个案例研究,我们把不同分布的数据集的异质注释水平结合起来。 目标是大幅增加培训数据的数量。 我们在PASCAL VOC [7] 和BDD100k [28] 的数据集上测试这个想法,并附有其实例分解和对象检测说明. PASCAL VOC的训练数据集包括6,929个口罩和27,450个框注,而BDD100k则有89,098个口罩和822,072个框注. 对于两个数据集,我们分别对培训组进行培训,并对验证组进行评估。 我们使用AnsMixer的口罩和盒子说明来跟踪我们的MixSIS配制,而Mask R-CNN只使用口罩说明.

blocks.en: Table 6 displays the results on the PASCAL VOC dataset. Given the additional box annotations, our AnnsMixer outperforms Mask R-CNN based on mask annotations by 0.097 in mAP (+34%). This indicates the strong positive influence of the additional images with box annotations. Note that also in the precise segmentation results (mAP 75 ), AnnsMixer with additional box annotations outperforms Mask R-CNN relying only on mask annotations. Hence, the pseudo masks derived from the boxes in AnnsMixer have a high quality. A similar behavior is visible on the BDD100k dataset. The results in Tab. 7 show a 0.037 improvement in mAP of AnnsMixer using boxes and masks over vanilla Mask R-CNN. While the improvement is lower compared to PASCAL VOC, a strong positive influence of the additional box annotations is clearly visible.

blocks.en: 6.3 Dataset Merging with MixSIS
blocks.zh: 6.3 数据集与MixSIS合并

blocks.en: The final case study takes the annotation merging one step further. Here, we merge datasets on the same or overlapping recognition tasks, which feature different annotation types. The goal is, similar to the annotation merging, increasing the amount of training data for a specific task. Note that we do not consider any kind of domain adaptation and leave this for future work since we focus on a proof-of-concept. In this study, we select two recognition task: (a) apple detection and (b) general instance segmentation.
blocks.zh: 最后的案例研究将说明进一步合并。 在这里,我们合并了相同或重叠识别任务的数据集,这些数据集具有不同的注释类型。 目标是,与注释合并相似,增加特定任务的培训数据。 请注意,我们不考虑任何领域调整,而是将此留给今后的工作,因为我们侧重于概念的证明。 在这项研究中,我们选择了两项识别任务:(a) 苹果检测和(b) 一般实例分解。

blocks.en: For the apple detection, we merge the dataset MinneApple [ 8 ] , which features 670 training images with 28,183 apples annotated with masks, and the MAD dataset [ 10 ] with 105 images containing 14,667 apples annotated with boxes. As a baseline, we train Mask R-CNN only on MinneApple’s training set and evaluate on its test set. Leveraging the additional knowledge of the MAD dataset, we train our AnnsMixer with both mask annotations from MinneApple and box annotations from the entire MAD dataset. Subsequently, we also evaluate it on MinneApple’s test set. The results in Tab. 8 show that despite the absence of domain adaptation and a substantial domain gap (industrial orchard vs. freestanding trees, apple density, and apple size), the additional training data from MAD in AnnsMixer already improves the mAP by about 2%.
blocks.zh: 对于苹果检测,我们合并了数据集MinneApple [8],该数据集的特色是670个训练图像和28,183个带有口罩的苹果加注,MAD数据集 [10] 和105个包含14,667个苹果加注盒的图像. 作为基线,我们只用MinneApple的训练装置来训练Mask R-CNN,并在测试装置上进行评估。 利用MAD数据集的额外知识,我们用明尼阿普尔的面具说明和整个MAD数据集的框说明来训练我们的AnsMixer. 随后,我们还在MinneApple的测试中进行了评估。 塔布结果. 8 显示,尽管没有域位适应,且域位差距很大(工业果园对独立树,苹果密度,苹果大小),安斯密瑟的MAD的额外培训数据已经将mAP提高了约2%.

blocks.en: For general instance segmentation, we merge the 6,929 mask annotations from PASCAL VOC’s [ 7 ] training dataset with the 492,812 annotations of the COCO training dataset, which overlap with the 20 object classes in PASCAL VOC. However, we do not take the mask annotations from COCO, but downgrade them to image-level annotations. Doing so allows us to study a practical case that utilizes image-level annotations in the MixSIS setup. The results in Tab. 9 clearly show the benefit of using abundant image-level annotations in this case. The results in mAP improve by 11 % 11\% from only using mask annotations to combining mask and image-level annotations in a MixSIS setting using our AnnsMixer. Note that while this particular case might be artificial, it shows that image-level annotations are also relevant in MixSIS and should not be overlooked.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduced a new task, MixSIS, to make the traditional WSIS formulation more flexible by allowing a mixture of different annotation levels even within a single image. To address MixSIS, we proposed the pioneering baseline system AnnsMixer, which produces pseudo annotation masks for all annotation levels in a single system. Our evaluation demonstrates that AnnsMixer largely outperforms state-of-the-art systems in WSIS and MixSIS. To highlight the practical relevance of the MixSIS task, we presented three case studies, leading to reduced annotation time (-90%) or improved the segmentation quality (+34%) through leveraging AnnsMixer’s unique features. Overall, MixSIS has a strong potential to aid practical instance segmentation applications by reducing the annotation effort.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出了一个新的任务,即MixSIS,通过允许将不同的注释级别混合在一起,甚至在单一图像中,使信息社会世界峰会的传统表述更加灵活。 为了解决MixSIS问题,我们提出了开创性的基准系统AnsMixer,它为单一系统中的所有注解水平生产伪注解口罩. 我们的评价表明,AnnsMixer在信息社会世界峰会和MixSIS中基本上超越了最先进的系统。 为了强调MixSIS任务的实际意义,我们提出了三个案例研究,通过利用AnnsMixer的独特性来缩短注释时间(-90%)或改善分化质量(+34%)。 总体而言,MixSIS有很大的潜力通过减少注释努力来帮助实际实例分解应用.
